import numpy as np
def equation(t, x, v, params):
    w = params[9]
    C = np.cos(w*t); S = np.sin(w*t)
    return (params[0] + params[1]*np.sqrt(x)*np.tanh(v) + params[2]*np.tanh(v)*C
            + params[3]*np.exp(-x)/v + params[4]*np.exp(-x)*np.exp(-v)
